title: Home page
descriptionHtml:
Luxury Upholstered Beds Handmade in the UK

Welcome to Eagle Bed, a family bed maker in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. We design and handcraft every bed to order in our own workshop, on solid wood frames, in six premium fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé.

Shop Our Bed Collections

Whether you are looking for a statement wingback bed, a practical ottoman storage bed, a classic Chesterfield bed, a stylish divan bed, a space-saving storage bed or a luxury upholstered bed frame, Eagle Bed has a design for your bedroom. We also make kids beds and upholstered headboards, and sell mattresses.

Why Choose Eagle Bed?

  • Every bed handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop
  • Solid wood frames
  • Six premium fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone
  • Single, Small Double, Standard Double, King and Super King
  • Free delivery across Great Britain in 3 to 5 working days (Northern Ireland £90)
  • 14-day free returns and a 5-year frame warranty
  • Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay

Popular Styles

Our wingback beds have tall winged headboards that create a luxurious, enveloping feel. Ottoman gas lift storage beds suit bedrooms where space is at a premium, with storage under the whole mattress and a smooth hydraulic lift. For classic British elegance, our Chesterfield beds have deep-buttoned headboards that look striking in Plush Velvet. For families, our kids upholstered beds are soft and made to the same standard.

Delivery

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. See our delivery information.

Quality You Can Trust

Every Eagle Bed frame is built to last, crafted with care in West Yorkshire and backed by a 5-year warranty, with 14-day free returns. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm).
